paper.title: egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation

contribution.title: Deferred e-graph rebuilding
contribution.summary: Defer congruence-invariant restoration until batches of unions and rewrites accumulate, then canonicalize and repair affected e-classes together. This amortizes redundant invariant-maintenance work during equality saturation.
contribution.paper_location: Section 3, “Rebuilding E-Graphs,” including the rebuilding algorithm and amortized-analysis discussion
contribution.metric: Repeated paired release-mode equality-saturation wall-clock time, excluding compilation and using warmups, while requiring congruence and canonicalization correctness and identical expected extraction results. `EGG_BENCH_CSV` supplies per-test timings, and Runner statistics expose rebuilding work. Bundled simple and selected math workloads require no external data and run within minutes on CPU.
